notes.title: Tormented Souls 2 release date revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, drumroll please… 🥁🥁🥁 [/h3][p][/p][p]It’s time to prepare yourselves for an entirely new nightmare as [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464280/Tormented_Souls_2/"]Tormented Souls 2[/url] launches on [b]23rd October 2025! [/b] [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the rapidly-approaching release of the next instalment in the series we’ve partnered with the [b]Future Games Show at Gamescom 2025[/b] to showcase a pulse-pounding [b]new gameplay trailer[/b], and reveal first details of the [b]monstrous bosses [/b]that Caroline will encounter while exploring the hellish[b] ‘Other side[/b]’ of Villa Hess.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/8130011b6809b1f4e03959fedfd11c99c204c303.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️⚠️WARNING! Spoilers for Tormented Souls ahead! ⚠️⚠️[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Check out the ‘A New Nightmare’ Gameplay Trailer as seen in the Future Games Show Gamescom Showcase![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="2tW08Oy7QmY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
In the wake of her sister [b]Anna’s[/b] traumatic abduction at the hands of [b]Mother Lucia [/b]and her twisted cult, [b]Caroline Walker[/b] finds herself trapped deep within the walls of a maze-like convent. With the darkness closing in, Caroline is unexpectedly reacquainted with her old friend, the pneumatic nailer, and so begins a desperate struggle to escape the unholy place. But once free of the convent, the true horror of the secluded [b]Villa Hess[/b] reveals itself and Caroline must again [b]call upon her supernatural abilities[/b] to travel to the town’s mysterious [b]‘Other side’[/b] and face the formidable creatures that await within…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Switching realities[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ce51573734c5757f933c3717242bf470475956ce.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b] it was Caroline’s latent supernatural powers that allowed her to[b] utilise mirrors and video tapes[/b] to traverse between [b]alternate realities[/b] and [b]timelines[/b] to ultimately save Anna from her cruel fate. [/p][p]
In [b]Tormented Souls 2[/b], Caroline will continue to embrace these powers as she steps into Villa Hess’ mysterious ‘Other side’ and ‘replays’ memories stored on video tapes. Crucially Caroline’s actions in these locations will directly affect the current timeline in Villa Hess, while revealing more about the town’s dark history.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The horrors of the ‘Other side’[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Only the [b]foulest and most dangerous creatures[/b] reside within the ‘Other side’ and Caroline must be extra vigilant when exploring this twisted new reality. Deadliest of all are[b] beings of immense power[/b] that have gorged on the misery and corruption that envelops the region. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2b84dd25ebd3bb1d8b6f349903891dfc5ee8c85d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Wielding a huge crucifix and protected by a heavy plated mask, the [b]Iron Maiden[/b] is a hulking behemoth and cruel disciplinarian who administers punishment amongst the convent’s sisterhood.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ebae69e4daf50e15406e4fdf7dcfa12b1d879c97.png"][/img][/p][p]
Meanwhile, deep beneath the stinking halls of the [b]Wildberger & Hess Fish Processing Plant[/b] sleeps [b]The Harvester[/b], a terrifying fusion of twisted metal and scorched flesh. Armed with a lethal buzzsaw and gaping maw filled with razor sharp teeth, this subterranean horror seems impervious to all but the heaviest of weapons. [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time!
[/p][p]Dual Effect & PQube[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Celebrate Halloween with a new update and a discount!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Horror Survival Fans[/h2]


Prepare yourselves for jump scares, fiendish puzzles, and a bloody good time!

We're excited to celebrate the spooky season with [b]a brand new update[/b] to Tormented Souls! One of the most requested in-game items for all of you was more [b]outfit options[/b], so we're pleased to show you all the concept art for the [b]new outfit[/b] option for Caroline.

This will be available at the very beginning of the game but that's all we'll tell you, the rest is up to you!
Join us in the Winterlake's mansion and check out the latest items available in-game now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/eb01014eea915ee0e67af1e110b9c02f176fd2f4.png[/img]

We're not ready to fully show you all this [b]new item[/b] but here is an x-ray vision of what's to be discovered once you have completed the game and faced the horrors of the mansion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/f35fd2297beb0fa11f07801197ba34d7e64536cc.png[/img]
To unlock this unique weapon, you'll have to find and solve a new puzzle. Once unlocked, you will still be able to use the weapon after the Halloween event has ended.

One last thing we're happy to announce is the [b]availability of the soundtrack for purchase![/b] You can buy this as a bundle with the game or separately so you can take the ambiance of Tormented Souls [b]wherever you go.[/b]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/cd71c12ccab075d49fb89ef21dfc6dcdbf2c30c7.png[/img]

[h2]Join Caroline Walker[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/fb5e38dad3e1846d4b072e6129f37c9e6df4a552.gif[/img]

Caroline Walker, an elementary school teacher, [b]received a strange letter with a photo of two twin girls[/b] from the Wildberger Hospital, located on Winterlake town in Blackwood island. After receiving the letter, Caroline [b]can’t continue with her normal life[/b] since she started to feel anxious during the day and had [b]horrible nightmares.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/265422dc52a993496c26259a5dc36d29f2f73413.gif[/img]

She started to see the little girls' faces in the photo as soon as she closed her eyes. After an awful week experiencing these strange symptoms, [b]she decided to go to Wildberger hospital and investigate who the girls in the photo were. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/349481bb0d83193c03361375e582b6e708e2fe6d.gif[/img]

[b]As soon as she enters[/b] the hospital, which way back was a mansion, [b]she is knocked down by a stranger, put into a bathtub, and connected to breathing machines.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ef61f657328b5338ae0ea1d0b88fc1453ab8c75d.gif[/img]

[h2]Tormented Souls will be coming to PC 27th August 2021[/h2]

Are you ready? 😨

notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/cd71c12ccab075d49fb89ef21dfc6dcdbf2c30c7.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, classic survival horror fans![/h2]

We just want to say [b]thank you so much to everyone[/b] who played the Tormented Souls Demo and we hope you all enjoyed the [b]thrill and mystery[/b] in the Winterlake Mansion. 

We've shown you but a [b]small portion of what to expect[/b] from Caroline's investigation for the twin girls and what lurks in the shadows...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/e54284adb582111705c317f384634031518c7556.gif[/img]

We've listened to your feedback and made [b]improvements[/b] to the overall demo:

[list]
[*] We're excited to announce we have added [b]New languages[/b] to the game: French, Rusian, German and Spanish.

[*] Caroline won't stop when encountering the [b]first enemy in the basement[/b] corridors, making a smoother transition.

[*] New document with [b]controls and instructions[/b] on how to back-dash and reload located in the X-Ray room 

[*] New light in the X-Ray corridor so you won't be [b]consumed by the darkness[/b] when you come back from the generator room.

[*] [b]New monsters trigger dying animation[/b] so you don’t have to waste ammo in order to check if the foes are dead or not.

[*] More [b]visible recording tapes[/b] so you don´t miss them. 

[*] In addition to the wallboard maps, [b]portable maps[/b] have been added so you can check your location whenever you want to avoid getting lost.

[*] Collider issues fixed.

[*] [b]Health items percentage[/b]: Morphine health restores 30% of life and Medical Kit restores 100% 

[*] Compatible with [b]PS5 and PS4 controllers[/b].

[*] Subtitles added to the cinematics.

[*]New Caroline opening cinematic added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/1fe63e66839c323a68c8ce654281039316e8f9a7.png[/img]

Hello again,

[u][h3]Closed Beta 2 Update[/h3][/u]
We will be running a Closed Beta for Tormented Souls and we have already received so much interest to help us take the game to the next level. We're sorry that to inform you that since we posted about the Beta yesterday, the dates have now changed to Wednesday 21/04/21 to Saturday 01/05/2021.
Please keep an eye on the Steam page for more information and also for future opportunities to help us test & improve Tormented Souls.

[*] Chinese (Simplified) 
[*] Czech
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean

notes.title: New Official Screenshots + Closed Beta Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Today we have two new Tormented Souls updates to share with you!

[u][h3]New Screenshots[/h3][/u]
We have just added a batch of new screenshots to the Steam page, taken from the latest build, which you can view at the top of the Steam page. We are still working hard on improving everything about Tormented Souls - but we hope that they give you even more of a flavour of what we're looking to bring to the game. Including... 

[b]Deadly Combat [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/6b13add8da2808b98d3d2828cce58de33da96cf0.png[/img]
Dark forces and unspeakable horrors will do everything in their power to stop Caroline getting to the truth. Use anything and everything that you can find to fight back against the evils that wait in the darkness. 

[b]Fiendish Puzzles[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/c09c22e7292673755b0c6907b400830997b69e1e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/9cd288e3268136a40f29fe523038923d4cfbc119.png[/img]
Scavenge essential resources and tools, manage your inventory, decipher clues from long-forgotten journals, and combine it all to solve fiendish puzzles and unravel the secrets of the mansion-turned-hospital. 

[b]Gateways to Another Dimension [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/70f8af01f4674d3f67eddccabd3f81e23a20d347.png[/img]
Nothing is as it seems at Winterlake. And when you discover a shimmering mirror in a dark corner of the mansion, your understanding of reality will be challenged in a whole new way... 

[u][h3]Closed Beta Update[/h3][/u]
We are currently running a Closed Beta for Tormented Souls and already we have received so much useful feedback to help us take the game to the next level. We're sorry that not everybody could take part in this Beta test, but please keep an eye on the Steam page for more information about the improvements we're making to the game - and also for future opportunities to help us test & improve Tormented Souls. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/0559ba8b401bae31228bbbbda51c12d268522276.png[/img]
[i][h3]Thanks for your support! [/h3][/i]
